Register how a parameter should be recast

Source: R/rules.R
register_scale_rule.Rd

Records the rule (and optionally the weight) to use for a named value column, so callers of recast_scale() need not repeat it. Downstream packages register their own parameter maps at load time.

Usage

register_scale_rule(param, rule, weight = NULL, scope = NULL)

Arguments

param

Name of the value column.

rule

One of SCALE_RULES.

weight

Optional weight column name used by sum (down) and weighted_mean (up). NULL means the scale's default weight.

scope

Optional dimension namespace (e.g. "calendar", "geoscale"). NULL registers the rule for every dimension.

Value

Invisibly, the registered entry.

Examples

register_scale_rule("capacity", "sum")
register_scale_rule("eff", "weighted_mean", weight = "count")
get_scale_rule("eff")
#> $rule
#> [1] "weighted_mean"
#> 
#> $weight
#> [1] "count"
#> 
#> $scope
#> NULL
#> 
clear_scale_rules(c("capacity", "eff"))
